name: AB Electronics
old_description: Since 1994, Innovative Electronics has been a leading partner in providing cutting-edge mechanical and electrical assembly solutions across diverse applications and industries. Our team excels in supporting your projects through every stage, from product development and design to contract manufacturing and sustaining services.
about:
AB Electronics was founded in 1994 in Danbury, Connecticut. The company operates as part of the Aragra Technologies group, which extends its manufacturing and distribution capabilities across a broader network.

The shop provides full-service electronics contract manufacturing, including surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly (with BGA capability), cable and harness assembly, electro-mechanical box builds, flexible circuit integration, conformal coating, potting, and functional testing. It also offers product development, design assistance, new product introduction, and sustaining services such as supply chain management, inventory control, and lifecycle support. The company describes its capacity as low-to-high volume, noting cable and harness orders ranging from ten pieces to over one thousand.

Its customer base spans industrial, military, rail, medical, automotive, and other highly regulated sectors. Clients range from original equipment manufacturers needing turnkey assembly to firms requiring design-for-manufacturability reviews and long-term sustaining engineering.

AB Electronics positions itself as an extension of its clients' teams, emphasizing transparent communication, continual investment in modern equipment and skilled personnel, and a regional manufacturing footprint with global reach. The stated purpose is to support American innovation by providing the capacity and resources to bring product designs to market.
